task_completion.description: Create a Markups Fiducial list named 'AnatomicalLandmarks' in the 3D Slicer subject hierarchy or Markups module.

task_completion.description: Place and label 8 distinct fiducial points corresponding to the required abdominal organs (Liver, Spleen, Right Kidney, Left Kidney, Aorta, IVC, Pancreas, and Portal Vein/Gallbladder).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Markups list contains 8 entries with the specific names of the organs, and corresponding glyphs are visible on the CT slices.

task_completion.description: Export the fiducials to the specific path ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/anatomical_landmarks.mrk.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save Data' dialog or a file browser window shows the file path and name correctly configured for export.

task_completion.description: Save the entire Slicer scene to the directory ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save Scene' or 'Save Data' dialog shows the destination directory as ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/.

task_completion.description: Save screenshots of the Axial (Red), Coronal (Green), and Sagittal (Yellow) views with the specified filenames.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the 'Screen Capture' module or 'Save' dialog to create briefing_axial.png, briefing_coronal.png, and briefing_sagittal.png.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI to place fiducials and save files rather than just executing terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the slice views and the Slicer module panels.

integrity.description: The fiducials are placed on the actual anatomical structures they label, not randomly in the image space.
integrity.visual_evidence: The colored fiducial markers in the Red/Green/Yellow slice views align with the correct organ morphology (e.g., Liver marker is in the upper right quadrant).

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the Slicer 'Save Data' interface to specify paths.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Slicer 'Save Data' window is visible with the 'File Name' and 'Storage Directory' columns modified by the agent.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task uses the AMOS 2022 dataset (case amos_0001). The agent must use the 'Markups' module in 3D Slicer. The 8 required labels are: Liver, Spleen, Right Kidney, Left Kidney, Aorta, IVC, Pancreas, and either Portal Vein or Gallbladder. All files must be saved specifically in ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/.
